name: Financial & analytics dashboard
summary: A dashboard that holds a lot without looking cramped: ten figures with sparklines on one surface, one main chart with its breakdown beside it, filters in one row and a sortable table of 24 accounts with a sticky header. Loading and error states.
anatomy: Sidebar + top bar → title + one filter row → 10 KPIs with sparklines → main chart (2/3) + breakdown (1/3) → 24-row table with sticky header, sparklines and health
